title: Lab Techniques and Projects I
description: Fundamental biochemical, microbiological and molecular biological laboratory techniques are applied to the development of practical and analytical laboratory skills in projects run as multi-week labs. Acquired laboratory techniques may include: bioinformatics; buffers; SDS-PAGE; protein purification; ELISA; Western blot; culturing hybridomas; enzyme kinetics.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MLSC 301A, BCMB 301A, BIOC 301.
